modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    person_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    shirt_patches = image_patch.find("shirt")
    
    if not person_patches or not shirt_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    person_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in person_patches]
    shirt_centers = [(s.left + s.right) / 2 for s in shirt_patches]
    
    closest_person = min(person_patches, key=lambda p: abs((p.left + p.right) / 2 - shirt_centers[0]))
    closest_shirt = min(shirt_patches, key=lambda s: abs((s.left + s.right) / 2 - person_centers[0]))
    
    if closest_person.overlaps_with(closest_shirt.left, closest_shirt.lower, closest_shirt.right, closest_shirt.upper):
        return closest_person
    
    return closest_person
